purpose: Preserve exact local release inputs, reproducibility evidence, and recovery inputs while Stage 3 awaits external authority.

recovery.docker_tag_restore: Load the corresponding canonical OCI archive with docker load and verify the loaded image ID against artifacts/execution-record.json before use.
recovery.evidence_restore: Archives and layouts are checksum-bound by artifacts/SHA256SUMS; restore only from a byte-identical retained evidence copy.

removal.docker_tags: After Supervisor acceptance, explicit supersession, or abandonment, remove only the three exact tags listed above with docker image rm; do not prune.
removal.archives_and_layouts: Retain through Stage 3 disposition. Any later cleanup must target the listed paths explicitly and preserve the checksum index and final result first.
